create_PuppetPolicy: create a PuppetPolicy wrapping a puppeteer and a puppet policy to control timestep transformation
run_PuppetPolicy_step: run the PuppetPolicy step method with a timestep and previous state to get an action and next state
get_PuppetPolicy_initial_state: get the initial state of a PuppetPolicy by combining puppeteer and puppet initial states
close_PuppetPolicy: close a PuppetPolicy to release the underlying puppet policy resources
test_PuppetPolicy: test the PuppetPolicy class that wraps a puppeteer to modify timesteps before forwarding to a puppet policy
